title: SEO Specialist
summary: An SEO specialist helps a website rank higher in search results by fixing technical issues, choosing keywords and earning links from other sites. The role sits in the marketing or growth team, works with developers and content writers, and reports on rankings and organic traffic.
dailyDuties: Check Search Console for crawl, index and ranking changes
Run site audits and file fixes with developers
Research keywords and map them to pages
Plan and track link building outreach
Write on-page recommendations and briefs for writers
Report rankings and organic traffic from GA4

skills.expectation: Run on-page, off-page and technical SEO for a website
Audit crawling, indexing, sitemaps, canonicals and schema, and get fixes shipped
Research keywords and map them to pages by search intent
Earn quality backlinks and audit the backlink profile
Work daily in Google Search Console and a crawler or research tool such as Ahrefs or Semrush
Read organic traffic and conversions in GA4
Track rankings and organic traffic and report them every month
Explain SEO changes to developers, writers and clients
Read page HTML to check tags, headings and structured data
Find and brief fixes for Core Web Vitals issues
Make on-page changes in WordPress or another CMS
Write SEO briefs for content writers
Understand how JavaScript rendering affects crawling
Work with large keyword and crawl exports

certifications.why: Free Google exam that covers GA4 reporting used for organic traffic analysis
Free HubSpot Academy course and exam on SEO fundamentals
